title: The shops are vast, multi storied and usually part closed/fully closing.
content: So this has been reoccurring for me lately. Very, very vivid dreams involving large shopping centres with many floors. Vast swathes with low lighting, and a large swimming complex with slides etc. Sometimes with unstable diving boards. One reoccurring factor though is that every stall is usually on the verge of closing? These dreams have been jumping out at me because they seem far too real. Almost like I'm moving between realities. Honestly a little shocked that other people are having the same experiences.
